citations.text: Panzarasa, Pietro, Opsahl, Tore, Carley, Kathleen M. (2009). Patterns and dynamics of users' behavior and interaction: Network analysis of an online community. Journal of the American Society for Information Science and Technology 60(5), 911-932.

description: Directed temporal multigraph of private messages sent on an online social network at UC Irvine. Each edge represents a message from one user to another; multiple messages between the same pair create multi-edges. No self-loops.
name: Opsahl UC Social Network
